scope: Finish and saved-result validation require a 22-record conservative-bound report. Four limits are proved by stronger all-geometry bounds: 380 nm drawn NSDM/PSDM widths and 210 nm poly spacing/notches. A failed sufficient bound leaves the narrower catalog rule unreviewed; no foundry violation is inferred. Eighteen IP blockage subjects are absent on their explicit published block purposes; present raw geometry or text keeps their requirements unreviewed. All 128 focused tests pass per OS, sixteen controls match exactly, and all three application runs plus Windows export replays pass. Original catalog counts are 409 executed, 586 absent, 90 W/L exemptions, 8 advisory and 463 unreviewed. Corrected streams retain 188 explicit current catalog messages. Generated-mask, density and complete physical qualification remain open.

cases.scope: Actual Runner export removes only the top-level prBoundary box matching the independent OpenDB die. Manufacturing masks and text are compared in full. Six partial geometry profiles, antenna, isolation, OpenDB checks and macro export rerun on the corrected GDS. Original timing/equivalence remains separate; no new extraction, full physical signoff or installer qualification. The retained 45-record core context is supplemented by 37 explicitly absent label, named-cell and raw-layer subjects; present subjects require further review. Four new VPP geometry checks execute, with absent capacitor targets on these references. Density observations do not establish density acceptance. Forty-four new module/seal interaction checks execute. Missing module or seal geometry does not establish complete-chip context. Thirty-six selected device requirements are measured: VPP, pwell resistor and PNP absence requires no drawn markers or candidate names/labels; two implant geometry checks execute with absent targets in these references. Four conservative bounds and eighteen raw IP blockage subjects are freshly checked; failed sufficient bounds and present blockages remain unreviewed. Earlier full catalog results retain their original GDS identities.

boundary_export.scope: Remove only the single top-level prBoundary box equal to the OpenDB die, if present. All other forbidden boundary-purpose input is rejected; manufacturing shapes and annotations are preserved.

conservative_bounds.scope: Four catalog limits are satisfied only when broader drawn-geometry checks pass: all merged NSDM and PSDM widths at least 380 nm, and all merged poly spacing/notches at least 210 nm. No core-gap or opposite-parallel exception is used. A failed sufficient bound is unreviewed, not a claimed violation of the narrower foundry rule. Eighteen IP blockage obligations are absent only when their exact published block purposes contain no raw data. Present blockages remain unreviewed; generated routing operands and hierarchy semantics are not implemented. Generated masks, global grid/density and complete physical coverage remain separate.

selected_devices.scope: Thirty-four VPP, pwell-resistor and PNP catalog records are absent only when their mandatory drawn purpose has no raw shapes and no reachable cell name or label suggests the device. Present candidates remain unreviewed. Separately, each gate (poly AND diff) overlapping tunm must be enclosed by tunm by 95 nm, and every drawn hvntm region must be inside hvi. Gates outside tunm are not selected by this enclosure check; their spacing and device intent remain separate. A SONOS name or label with no gate or with unselected gates keeps r453 unreviewed. Generated implants and complete device/density qualification are not established.

boundary_interactions.scope: Thirty-five published drawn-layer purposes are checked for straddling each supplied module-cut polygon on 81:10. Diffusion is checked for straddling seal 81:1; tap, poly, li1 and met1-met5 are checked for positive-area seal overlap. Targets are merged connected regions. Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

catalog_context.scope: Thirty-three explicitly core-selected geometry messages and one core-approval message require absence of all raw areaid.ce data; three LDNTM messages require absence of the actual implant subject. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Eight boundary prohibitions are checked directly. This is not complete catalog coverage or memory-device qualification.

catalog_labels.scope: Thirty-seven literal catalog messages are resolved only by complete absence of their selected label, named-cell or raw-layer subject. Labels are searched on every purpose and through the hierarchy; case, Unicode compatibility, whitespace and embedded-token variants conservatively prevent absence. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Unmarked floating nets, redundant vias, chip part-number requirements and the construction of module/frame regions remain separate.

vpp_geometry.scope: Selected rules on merged capacitor drawing 82:64: 1.43 um minimum width, no straddling nwell or dnwell, and 1.5 um enclosure for capacitors overlapping nwell. An outside-nwell capacitor leaves the enclosure requirement unreviewed; missing nwell never proves exemption. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths. Density operands are measured per connected capacitor region without selecting device exceptions or claiming density acceptance. Other VPP rules remain separate.

limitations: Four numeric implications use stricter all-geometry predicates. No core-gap, opposite-parallel or named-cell exception is invoked to accept these references.

A failing 210 nm poly bound can be legal under a narrower 175/160 nm rule; it therefore remains unreviewed, not a claimed foundry-rule violation. The existing six-profile application restrictions remain separate.

The eighteen IP blockage obligations are discharged only by complete raw-purpose absence on 67:10 through 72:10. Present blockages require the unresolved routing/hierarchy semantics. Magic fill exclusions are not substituted for these published IP blockage layers.
Merged regions preserve holes and notches. Unit orthogonal hierarchy and exact orthogonal paths are supported; unsupported geometry, units or transformations fail explicitly.

Sixteen controls cover exact limits, 1 nm bound failures, narrower legal candidate spacings that remain unreviewed, holes, merged fragments, reflected arrays, every IP blockage purpose and blockage text. Windows and Linux bytes agree.
Missing/altered reports and rehashed layouts carrying stale measurements fail current validation. Older saved reports require Finish rechecking.
Corrected streams retain 188 explicit current catalog messages. Historical full-catalog decisions stay tied to original GDS identities, and the separate six-profile periphery ledger is unchanged.
Manufacturing geometry, checkpoints, netlists and SPEF are unchanged. No new extraction, timing, complete physical signoff or foundry acceptance is claimed.
Thirty-six core/generated-mask records remain open. RF selectors, grid semantics, frame/pad context, pin-spacing definitions and required density/catalog coverage also remain unresolved.
